spec2def(serialui.dll serialui.spec)

# serialui.dll is all Rust (serialui-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/serialui-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# serialui.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/serialui-rust/src/serialui/serialui.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(serialui_res OBJECT serialui.rc)
target_compile_definitions(serialui_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(serialui_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(SERIALUI_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/crt/CMakeFiles/oldnames.dir/oldnames.a)
add_cargo_module(serialui serialui-cargo serialui.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE serialui-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS serialui_res ${SERIALUI_REUSED})
